F1: ClientCredentialsGrantType builds its token with `responseBuilder(...).generateAccessToken()` and never goes through `createTokenResponse`, so nothing sets `Constants.GRANT_TYPE`; the new `initToken` (TokenManager.java:1052-1054) then encodes the grant as `na`, and the `cc`/`pg` shortcuts are never emitted for these tokens.
F2: Line 73 of AccessTokenContext.java calls `requireNonNull(grantType, "Null rawTokenId not allowed")`, so a null `rawTokenId` passes the check and gets encoded as `...:null`, which breaks the constructor's stated contract.
